title: Manage and Prepare Data for Bayesian Meta-Analysis
text: bayesmaDatR designed around upload → manage → prepare → export workflow. Use Shiny app work Excel workbook, use data structures R script reproducible analysis pipeline.

title: Manage and Prepare Data for Bayesian Meta-Analysis
text: Excel-first workflow: upload, edit, validate, download workbook. Outcome-specific data: keep outcome’s sample sizes, time point, summary statistics, trial-design correlations outcome. Multiple trial designs: record RCT, crossover RCT, cluster RCT, cluster-crossover RCT data. Flexible summaries: retain means SDs, medians quantiles, ranges, event counts, person-time. Model-ready formats: prepare arm-level data one-stage, multivariate, multiarm, longitudinal models, calculate two-stage yi sei. Bias assessments: manage supported robbR tools INSPECT-SR assessments workbook.

title: Manage and Prepare Data for Bayesian Meta-Analysis
text: workbook can contain four sheets: studies, outcomes, risk_of_bias, inspect_sr. original app’s sheet names study_details, outcome_data, rob_data also recognized. Start template_ma_data() see recommended columns:

title: Manage and Prepare Data for Bayesian Meta-Analysis
text: Supported two-stage measures include odds ratios (), risk ratios (RR), incidence-rate ratios (IRR), mean differences (MD), standardized mean differences (SMD), differences medians (MedD). median-reported outcomes, convert_median_to_mean() can estimate means SDs using Wan quantile-estimation (qe) method. calculations use optional metamedian package.
code: dat <- read_ma_workbook("review.xlsx") validate_ma_data(dat)  # Two-stage data: one row per study/outcome with yi and sei es_dat <- as_bayesma(   dat,   outcome = "pain_24h",   model_type = "two_stage",   measure = "MD" )  # Arm-level data for one-stage or multivariate models arm_dat <- as_bayesma(   dat,   outcome = "pain_24h",   model_type = "one_stage" )

title: Manage and Prepare Data for Bayesian Meta-Analysis
text: Risk--bias records identify tool assessment level. Use rob_level = "study" assessment applied across study’s outcomes, rob_level = "outcome" rating applies one outcome; outcome-level records require outcome_id. INSPECT-SR sheet includes 21 assessment items auxiliary values used Carlisle, participant-number consistency, GRIM, p-value checks. inspect_sr_columns() lists fields inspect_sr_labels() gives display labels. INSPECT-SR judgements recorded reviewer; package infer overall judgement auxiliary calculations.

title: Manage and Prepare Data for Bayesian Meta-Analysis
text: bayesmaDatR active development. workbook, validation, data preparation functions expanded alongside package-specific exporters. current as_bayesma() interface prepares common data frame; verify model-specific requirements fitting analysis.

title: bayesmaDatR 0.1.0
text: Initial release: workbook--model data manager Bayesian meta-analysis. launch_data_entry() card-based workbook manager bayesma’s data entry app, rebuilt bayesmaDatR schema: upload workbook map columns XLSX/CSV/RDA/RDS file, edit Study Details, Outcome Details, Risk Bias (robbR tools, coloured rating buttons guides) INSPECT-SR, sync studies across sections, validate, preview download bayesma data, download workbook, single sections template. Study Details gains n_periods; mean cluster size N / (n_clusters x n_periods), 1 period cluster trials 2 cluster crossover trials missing. merge_ma_data() (single-sheet workbook) now one row per study, outcome’s columns side side, suffixed outcome (e.g. n_int_hosp_los). write_ma_workbook(object_name = ) app name data frame(s) .rda file; prefixed section names (e.g. los_studies) recognised upload. Missing variances (e.g. SD IQR) longer stop export: study kept, yi/sei left empty calculated, warning names missing fields. MedD failures also warn. Exports Study Details downloads use fixed column order: study_id, author, year, trial_design, control, intervention, n_int, n_ctrl, n_clusters, rho_w, rho_b, rho_wp (empty design columns omitted), extra study columns; outcome’s outcome_id, measure, n_int … q3_ctrl, design_effect, yi, sei; risk--bias columns. Import: “columns keep” brings study columns (e.g. subgroup1, subgroup2) names. subgroup follow_up longer template fields. launch_data_entry() opens web browser default, RStudio’s viewer save downloads; failed downloads show error app. app’s export “Format” offers package-neutral “Standard” layout MetaStan. as_bayesma() exports several outcomes side side wide format: one row per study, outcome columns suffixed outcome (yi_hosp_los, sei_icu_los, …). Study rows reported data outcome left message. app’s export takes several outcomes. design_effect always calculated (read-app, imported). Import: outcome block sheet, header row study identifiers; column tag re-matches changed matches tags middle names (e.g. Mean_LOS_ICU_int). Study Details holds study-level n_int, n_ctrl, n_clusters, rho_w, rho_b rho_wp; outcome rows inherit cells empty (fill_study_defaults()), outcome-specific values need entering differ. cluster_size replaced n_clusters; mean cluster size derived N / clusters (N / (2 x clusters) cluster crossover trials). Outcome Data download includes inherited values. write_ma_workbook() app’s workbook download can save .rda file (one data frame per section, one merged data frame). Missing design-effect inputs give design effect 1; cluster crossover trials without rho_b use rho_b = 0. Outcomes carry design_effect column, filled import, fill_design_effect() app’s “Recalculate design effect” button; typed value used given. Trial design codes normalised (e.g. CXRCT, XRCT, cluster crossover become cxo_rct, xo_rct); CLARITY’s yes/answers map judgements (e.g. “Probably ” Probably high). Imports drop columns skipped (left empty); “Manage columns” “Drop empty columns” button. Tables row checkboxes removing several rows . trial_design now lives Study Details (outcome-level value still overrides ). Outcomes gain cluster_size design effect. compute_design_effect() ports bayesma’s design effects; compute_effect_size(), as_bayesma() as_MetaStan() use effective sample sizes yi/sei (design_effect = "ignore" switch ) keep reported n_int n_ctrl alongside n_int_eff, n_ctrl_eff design_effect. as_MetaStan() exports one outcome MetaStan’s arm-based format (arm 1 = control, multi-arm supported) , default, runs MetaStan::create_MetaStan_dat(). merge_ma_data() combines every section one data frame; write_ma_workbook(layout = "single") writes one sheet. App: hide skipped fields mapping, fill new Study Details column uploaded file, choose bayesma MetaStan design effect exporting, download workbook separate sheets one sheet. split_iqr() split_range() split Q1/Q3 min/max reported one cell; importer iqr_* range_* columns. Import mappings can take several columns per field, using first non-empty value per study (e.g. outcome-specific N, overall N). outcome column tag (e.g. hosplos) matches columns N_hosplos_int ahead N_int. Continuous outcomes carry mean/SD, median, quartiles range together; as_bayesma(estimate_means = "wan"/"qe") app’s export card estimate missing means SDs MD/SMD. convert_median_to_mean() fills arms default. Imports can take section file sheet, header row per section title rows column names skipped. Recognised sheets (studies, outcomes, risk_of_bias, inspect_sr) can loaded -without replacing sections. Workbook schema outcome-specific sample sizes, mean/SD, median/quartile/ range, event person-time summaries, trial_design (rct, xo_rct, c_rct, cxo_rct), rho_w/rho_b/rho_wp, int_arm/ctrl_arm multi-arm studies. read_ma_workbook(), write_ma_workbook(), map_ma_columns(), sync_ma_data() validate_ma_data(). Risk bias eight robbR tools: rob_tools(), rob_domains(), rob_judgements() add_rob() rob_level = "study" "outcome". compute_effect_size() (, RR, IRR, MD, SMD, MedD) using bayesma’s rules convert_median_to_mean() (Wan QE via metamedian). select_outcome(), prepare_arm_data(), prepare_outcome() as_bayesma() exporter (wide long, one- two-stage). INSPECT-SR sheet 21 assessment items auxiliary calculation fields.
